scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof for an idealized linear-response model; the self-review checks formal claims and a standalone numeric cross-check, with no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three equal-strength uncoupled Debye processes with geometrically spaced relaxation times; no arbitrary amplitudes, coupling, experimental resolution model, or non-Debye relaxation.
title: Sharp one-to-three peak transition for three geometric Debye relaxations
